hard_fail_conditions: Any paid action without specific user approval.
Any live order/trade or wallet action without specific user approval.
Any promotion that overrides a failed required gate.
Any point-in-time leakage accepted as valid evidence.
Any deleted/suppressed negative evidence used to improve a thesis.
Any known survivor benchmark killed solely because it was waiting for data.
Any independent-reproduction pass where shared upstream evidence was knowingly ignored.
replacement_rule: All hard-fail conditions must remain false.
V1 must show no material regression in survivor preservation, false-survivor control, or provenance completeness.
V1 must show a strict improvement in at least two of: unique evidence efficiency, duplicate reduction, decisive falsification efficiency, contradiction detection, source-family coverage.
If quality improves only by materially increasing usage/coordination, retain the simpler baseline unless the gain is operationally important and documented.
If results differ by task shape, adopt task-shape-specific concurrency rather than forcing one global worker count.
